scripts.build: npm run build -w @mcpforge/shared && npm run build -w @mcpforge/inspector && npm run build -w @mcpforge/core && npm run build -w @mcpforge/runtime && npm run build -w @x123martin/mcpforge-cli
scripts.demo: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/index.js generate examples/petstore.yaml -o examples/petstore.mcpforge.json && node packages/cli/dist/index.js inspect --manifest examples/petstore.mcpforge.json
scripts.release: npm run build && npm publish -w @x123martin/mcpforge-cli --access public
